events.description: A new feature was added to Service Control for additional quota policy checks; the code change and binary release were rolled out region by region, but the new code path was never exercised because it required a policy change to trigger it. A red-button to disable that serving path was included.

A policy change with unintended blank fields was inserted into the regional Spanner tables used by Service Control and replicated globally within seconds; Service Control then exercised the new code path, which hit a null pointer and put the binaries into a crash loop globally in each regional deployment.
Within 2 minutes of the start of the incident, the Site Reliability Engineering team was triaging the incident.
Multiple GCP products began experiencing service issues (as stated in the 11:46 status update).
Within 10 minutes of the start of the incident, the cause was identified and the red-button to disable the serving path was being put in place.
The red-button was ready to roll out, approximately 25 minutes from the start of the incident.
Within 40 minutes of the incident, the red-button rollout was completed and recovery began across regions, starting with the smaller ones.
Status update posted: multiple GCP products experiencing service issues; engineering investigating; no workaround available.
The first incident report was posted to Cloud Service Health, delayed because Cloud Service Health infrastructure was down due to the outage.
Status update: issue recovered in some locations; no ETA on full mitigation.

events.time: June 12, 2025 shortly after recovery began in larger regions (US/Pacific)
events.description: As Service Control tasks restarted in larger regions such as us-central1, a herd effect overloaded the underlying Spanner table infrastructure; the team throttled task creation and routed traffic to multi-regional databases.
Status update: all locations except us-central1 fully recovered; us-central1 mostly recovered.
Underlying dependency recovered in all locations except us-central1.
Infrastructure recovered in all regions except us-central1; issues persisted on us-central1 and multi-region/us.
Most Google Cloud products fully recovered (as stated in the 15:16 status update).
Mitigation implemented for us-central1 and multi-region/us; signs of recovery observed.
Most Google Cloud products confirmed full service recovery; a few services still showed residual impact.
Residual impact noted: Dataflow backlog clearing gradually, Vertex AI Online Prediction elevated 5xx errors on some Model Garden models, Personalized Service Health updates delayed.
Vertex AI Model Garden 5xx errors resolved (as stated in the 17:59 status update).
Dataflow backlog cleared in all regions except us-central1.
Dataflow fully resolved (as stated in the 17:33 status update).
Personalized Service Health resolved; only remaining impact was Vertex AI Online Prediction.
Status update: Vertex AI Model Garden 5xx errors resolved; serving back to normal except europe-west1 and asia-southeast1.
Vertex AI Online Prediction fully recovered (as stated in the 18:27 status update).
Status update: all services fully recovered.
